My name is on this small piece near the house, only a little plot, but maize is our food so I must give it proper care. I will try to get the subsidy fertilizer coupon like last year — without the fertilizer this soil is tired and the cobs come out small. I am planting the hybrid seed again because it gave better yield than the local one my father used, and I will mix in some pigeon peas between the rows as we always do. The fall armyworm has been bad these past seasons, so I keep a little bottle of cypermethrin to spray when I see the damage on the young leaves. I have no pump and no river nearby, so I wait for the rains like everyone here. My wife and two older children help me, and for weeding time I sometimes call a neighbour and pay him with a bit of money or food.
